RAD-001.name: Amateur Demolitionist
RAD-001.rulesText: When you play me, play a Bomb gear token to a battlefield.
RAD-001.flavorText: "What's the worst that can happen—it doesn't blow up?"

RAD-002.name: Banner of Conquest
RAD-002.flavorText: When Noxus raises a banner, there will be blood before it lowers.

RAD-003.name: Bilgewater Tracker
RAD-003.rulesText: When you play me, deal 1 to each of up to 2 units.
RAD-003.flavorText: "Who's on top of the bounty board today?"

RAD-004.name: Brawl
RAD-004.rulesText:
[Action]
Give a unit [Assault] this turn equal to its Might.
RAD-004.flavorText: No biting, not hits below the belt—unless you want to win.

RAD-005.name: Lingering Animus
RAD-005.rulesText: I enter ready if a friendly unit or gear died this turn.
RAD-005.flavorText: A drop of blood, a piercing shriek, a lingering silence.

RAD-006.name: Scorched Earth
RAD-006.rulesText:
[Action]
Deal 5 damage split among units at a single battlefield.

RAD-007.name: Rally for War
RAD-007.rulesText: Choose an occupied enemy battlefield. Play three 1[M] Recruit unit tokens there.
RAD-007.flavorText: When the first horn sounds, every solider thinks they'll make it home.

RAD-008.name: War Scout
RAD-008.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When you play me, give a unit +2[M] this turn.
RAD-008.flavorText: "I didn't say 'annoy them.' I said 'badger them.'"

RAD-009.name: Antagonistic Apparatus
RAD-009.rulesText:
I enter ready.
When you play me, play a ready 3[M] Mech unit token here.
RAD-009.flavorText: "Uh-oh! Looks like there's a surprise on the track ahead!"

RAD-010.name: Forbidden Technique
RAD-010.rulesText:
Ready a unit.
When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, you may play this from your trash for [1][R][R]. Then banish this.

RAD-011.name: Incorrigible Construct
RAD-011.rulesText:
[Show Off] a Mech.
I enter ready if you showed off.

RAD-012.name: Runeblade Anvil
RAD-012.rulesText:
When you play this or when this leaves the board, banish the top card of your Main Deck. Until your next Ending Phase, you may play that card.
[2][R], [E]: Kill this.

RAD-013.name: Lost to the Sands
RAD-013.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose one —
• Deal 4 to a unit at a battlefield.
• Kill a gear.
RAD-013.flavorText: Broken bodies. Broken landmarks. Broken dreams.

RAD-014.name: Shimmering Swimmer
RAD-014.rulesText:
You may kill a friendly unit or gear as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, deal 2 to a unit.
RAD-014.flavorText: One person's trash is another person's ammunition.

RAD-015.name: Akali, Brash
RAD-015.rulesText:
The first time I move each turn, [Add] [1][A].
The second time I move each turn, banish the top card of your Main Deck. Until your next Ending Phase, you may play that card.

RAD-016.name: Coalesced Energy
RAD-016.rulesText: At the end of your turn, recycle all your runes, then channel 4 runes exhausted.

RAD-017.name: Detonation Amplifier
RAD-017.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this, you may kill another friendly unit or gear to draw 1.
Friendly [Deathknell] effects here trigger an additional time.

RAD-018.name: Drakehound Packmaster
RAD-018.rulesText: When you play me, reveal the top card of each opponent's Main Deck. Choose one and banish it, then play it, ignoring its cost. Recycle the rest.
RAD-018.flavorText: "You've got the scent, my pets. Now hunt."

RAD-019.name: Firebrand Raider
RAD-019.rulesText:
I enter ready.
When you play me, ready all enemy units.
Other units enter ready.
Units can't ready during the Awaken Phase.

RAD-020.name: Mordekaiser, Twice Slain
RAD-020.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
[Assault 3]
Once each turn, if I would die, you may kill a friendly unit to heal me, exhaust me, and recall me instead.

RAD-021.name: Ekko, Revolutionary
RAD-021.rulesText:
I enter ready.
[Assault]
[Action][>] Discard 1, [1][R]: Banish me, then play me to your base, ignoring my cost.

RAD-022.name: Whirling Twirligig
RAD-022.rulesText:
[E]: Play a Gold gear token exhausted.
Kill a friendly gear, [E]: Play a 1[M] Recruit unit token.
Kill a friendly unit, [E]: Play a 3[M] Mech unit token.

RAD-023.name: Ziggs, Short-Fused
RAD-023.rulesText:
When you play me, play a Bomb gear token to a battlefield.
Abilities of friendly gear deal 1 Bonus Damage.

RAD-024.name: Blossoming Dreamroot
RAD-024.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you win a combat here, draw 1.
RAD-024.flavorText: Not all who toil at the plow will live to taste the fruit.

RAD-026.name: Entrenched Boar
RAD-026.rulesText: You may have me enter ready. If you do, I can't move this turn.
RAD-026.flavorText: Outsiders fear the wolf, the hawk, and the bear. Locals fear the pig.

RAD-027.name: Iridescent Avian
RAD-027.rulesText: [E]: [Buff] a unit. If it's already buffed, give it +2[M] this turn instead.

RAD-028.name: Ki Burst
RAD-028.rulesText:
[Action]
As an additional cost to play this, exhaust a friendly unit.
[Stun] a unit.

RAD-029.name: Life from Stone
RAD-029.rulesText:
[Reaction]
As an additional cost to play this, exhaust a friendly unit.
Draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
RAD-029.flavorText: Hope grows in the unlikeliest places.

RAD-030.name: Sanctum Conservator
RAD-030.rulesText: When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, ready me.
RAD-030.flavorText: They pledged to save the dynasty. They should have specified how.

RAD-031.name: Stoic Ferryman
RAD-031.rulesText:
[Shield 3]
When you play me to a battlefield, you may move another unit you control here to your base.
RAD-031.flavorText: You're paying for passage, not conversation.

RAD-032.name: Battle Preparations
RAD-032.rulesText:
[Reaction]
[Show Off] a gear.
Give a unit +2[M] this turn. If you showed off, ready up to 2 runes.

RAD-033.name: Command: Attack
RAD-033.rulesText:
Choose one —
• Move a friendly gear with [Deploy] to a battlefield.
• Look at the top 5 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal a gear from among them and draw it. Recycle the rest.

RAD-034.name: Hunker Down
RAD-034.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Ready a friendly unit. It can't move this turn. Draw 1.

RAD-035.name: Invigorating Bloom
RAD-035.rulesText:
When you play this, give a friendly unit +3[M] this turn.
Exhaust a friendly [Mighty] unit, [E]: Draw 1.
RAD-035.flavorText: Nature's bounty, there for the taking.

RAD-036.name: Storm Raptor
RAD-036.rulesText:
[Deflect]
When a stunned enemy unit here dies, draw 1.

RAD-038.name: Ahri, Confident
RAD-038.rulesText:
[Disarm]
When you reduce the Might of an enemy unit here by 1 or more, give me +1[M] this turn.

RAD-039.name: Ephemeral Ward
RAD-039.rulesText:
Your units have +2[M].
When you play a unit, kill this.
RAD-039.flavorText: Never underestimate the power of a good story.

RAD-040.name: Heartening Soul
RAD-040.rulesText:
When you play me, ready a friendly legend.
Friendly legends have "[E]: Give a unit +3[M] this turn."

RAD-041.name: Hush
RAD-041.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Counter a spell with Power cost [A][A] or more.

RAD-042.name: Orianna, Exquisite
RAD-042.rulesText:
[Shield]
I don't deal combat damage unless there's a friendly gear here.

RAD-043.name: Riven, Broken Blade
RAD-043.rulesText:
When I become exhausted, choose one that hasn't been chosen this turn —
• [Buff] me.
• Spend my buff to [Stun] an enemy unit.
• Spend my buff to ready me.

RAD-044.name: Hunting Blind
RAD-044.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this, you may move an enemy unit to this battlefield.
Friendly units here have [Shield 2].
RAD-044.flavorText: No one ever won a war without preparing.

RAD-045.name: K'Sante, Dauntless
RAD-045.rulesText:
[Shield]
When I attack or defend, double the [Shield] of a unit you control here this turn.

RAD-046.name: Resplendent Rostrum
RAD-046.rulesText:
[E]: Draw 1 and channel 1 rune exhausted.
When this become exhausted, give a friendly unit +3[M] this turn.
RAD-046.flavorText: Power and glory have no need for subtlety.

RAD-047.name: Fanfare
RAD-047.rulesText: The next three times you play a unit this turn, draw 1.
RAD-047.flavorText: "Please welcome our next performer to the stage!"

RAD-048.name: High Note
RAD-048.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Give a unit -[M] this turn equal to the number of exhausted units you control.

RAD-049.name: Industrious Mechsmith
RAD-049.rulesText: When you play me, play a 3[M] Mech unit token here.
RAD-049.flavorText: There's always time to make new friends.

RAD-051.name: Parallel Convergence
RAD-051.rulesText:
As an additional cost to play this, return a friendly unit to its owner's hand.
Deal 5 to a unit at a battlefield.

RAD-052.name: Resource Extractor
RAD-052.rulesText:
[Deploy]
At the end of your turn, if you control this battlefield, play a Gold gear token exhausted.

RAD-053.name: Strigian Oracle
RAD-053.flavorText: He knokws the what and hte when, but don't ask him who.

RAD-054.name: Trinket Peddler
RAD-054.flavorText: "It's really good stuff! Or at any rate, it's really stuff."

RAD-056.name: Improvised Projectile
RAD-056.rulesText:
[Action]
Choose a friendly gear. Deal damage equal to its Energy cost to a unit at a battlefield.
RAD-056.flavorText: Sometimes the solution is right in front of your face. Sometimes it's in front of some else's.

RAD-057.name: Piltovan Guidebot
RAD-057.rulesText: When you play a card, you may have my base Might become equal to that card's Energy cost this turn.

RAD-058.name: Riptide Mage
RAD-058.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When you play me, give an enemy unit -3[M] this turn.
RAD-058.flavorText: If they can't breathe, they can't fight.

RAD-059.name: Supernova
RAD-059.flavorText: Death and rebirth, played out on a cosmic scale.

RAD-060.name: The Empyrean
RAD-060.rulesText:
[Show Off] a card.
When you play me, if you showed off a card, [Predict] equal to its Power cost, then draw 2.

RAD-061.name: Ekko, Ingenious
RAD-061.rulesText:
As an additional cost to play me, return a friendly unit to its owner's hand.
[Ganking]

RAD-062.name: Gravity Field
RAD-062.rulesText:
[Deploy]
Opponents must pay [1][A] to move one or more units to this battlefield.
[Deathknell][>] Draw 1.

RAD-063.name: Kai'Sa, Rebel
RAD-063.rulesText:
[Disarm]
While I'm in a showdown, your spells have [Reaction].
RAD-063.flavorText: "It's a good day for a hunt."

RAD-064.name: Scrutinizing Scope
RAD-064.rulesText: [1], [E]: Choose an opponent. They guess a card type. Reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it has that type, recycle it. Otherwise, draw it.
RAD-064.flavorText: Safety measures were out of scope.

RAD-065.name: Seraphine, Inspiring
RAD-065.rulesText:
[Disarm 2]
Once each turn, when you exhaust three or more friendly units at the same time, you may draw 1.
RAD-065.flavorText: "Hello, world! I'm Seraphine, and you are beautiful!"

RAD-066.name: Spirit of the Forge
RAD-066.rulesText:
You may return a friendly gear to its owner's hand as an additional cost to play me.
When you play me, if you paid the additional cost, ready me and give me +[M] this turn equal to the Energy cost of the gear you returned.

RAD-067.name: Clocktower Guardian
RAD-067.rulesText:
When you play me or when I hold, [Predict 3].
[Deathknell][>] Banish the top card of your Main Deck. You may play it, ignoring its Energy cost.

RAD-068.name: Orianna, Mechanical Marvel
RAD-068.rulesText: Once each turn, while I'm at a battlefield, you may pay [1][A] less to play a gear.

RAD-069.name: Zero Point Inflection
RAD-069.rulesText:
When you play a card, draw 2.
When you draw 1 or more cards with 9 or more other cards in your hand, discard your hand, kill this, and choose an opponent. They score 1 point.
RAD-069.flavorText: Unlimited power always seems like a good idea at first.

RAD-070.name: Hold 'Em
RAD-070.rulesText:
[Action]
This costs [2] less if you've played a unit or gear to a battlefield this turn.
Give a unit +3[M] this turn.
RAD-070.flavorText: You can't choose the cards you're dealt—only how you play the hand.

RAD-072.name: Overloaded Traveler
RAD-072.rulesText: While there's a friendly gear with [Deploy] at my battlefield, I have +1[M].
RAD-072.flavorText: Bandle Scout Rule 321: If your backpack's not bursting, there's more you can bring!

RAD-073.name: Pillaged Armory
RAD-073.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this or when you conquer here, [Buff] a friendly unit.

RAD-074.name: Raving Witness
RAD-074.rulesText: When I move, reveal the top card of your Main Deck. If it's [Mighty], draw it. Otherwise, recycle it.
RAD-074.flavorText: They're just tall tales, until they're not.

RAD-075.name: Skystrike Squadron
RAD-075.rulesText:
You may return a friendly gear to its owner's hand as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I cost [2] less.
[Deflect]

RAD-076.name: Sneaky Zeebles
RAD-076.flavorText: "A zeeble gave it to you? You expect me to believe that?!"

RAD-077.name: Wrath of the Freljord
RAD-077.flavorText:
"The crackle of ice, the thunder of hooves, and then everything was chaos."
—Survivor's tale

RAD-078.name: Armored Tusker
RAD-078.rulesText:
[Shield 3]
[Tank]
When I move, you may deal damage equal to my [Shield] to a unit at a battlefield.
RAD-078.flavorText: It puts up a fight you'll never forget.

RAD-079.name: Avalanche
RAD-079.rulesText: Deal 3 to all units in bases.
RAD-079.flavorText: The only safe place to stand is somewhere else.

RAD-080.name: Bloodscent Swarm
RAD-080.rulesText: I cost [2] less for each battlefield you've conquered this turn.

RAD-081.name: Elnuk Herd
RAD-081.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, give a friendly unit +3[M] this turn, then recycle me if I was played from face down.
RAD-081.flavorText: In the Freljord, "stampede" is just another kind of weather.

RAD-082.name: Primordial Roar
RAD-082.rulesText:
[Show Off] a unit.
If you showed off a unit, deal damage eqal to that unit's Might to a unit.
RAD-082.flavorText: A taste of what's to come.

RAD-083.name: Stalwart Goatherd
RAD-083.rulesText:
[Shield 2]
When you play me, you may kill a gear with Energy cost [4] or less.

RAD-084.name: Cataclysm
RAD-084.rulesText:
Opponents can't play spells this turn.
Move a friendly unit to an occupied enemy battlefield.

RAD-085.name: Graves, Blasting Through
RAD-085.rulesText:
When I attack or defend, deal damage equal to my Might to all enemy units here.
I don't deal combat damage.

RAD-087.name: Portable Portal
RAD-087.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this, you may pay [B] to ready a unit here.
Units here have [Ganking].

RAD-088.name: Staunch Survivor
RAD-088.flavorText: Her home is lost, her family fallen. But there is always one thing left to fight for.

RAD-089.name: Titanic Shrine
RAD-089.rulesText: When you play a unit with Might great than each other unit on hte board, exhaust me to draw 1.
RAD-089.flavorText: Where the elements are feared, strength is revered.

RAD-090.name: Evelynn, Consuming
RAD-090.rulesText:
[Ambush]
When you play a card from face down, ready me and give me +1[M] this turn.
RAD-090.flavorText: "I was born of a thousand screams. What's one more?"

RAD-091.name: Jarvan IV, Martial Paragon
RAD-091.rulesText:
Your gear with [Deploy] have [Action].
When I conquer, if there is a friendly gear with [Deploy] here, channel 1 rune exhausted.
RAD-091.flavorText: "We shall rest when we are dead!"

RAD-092.name: Seraphic Wyvern
RAD-092.rulesText: If you would channel runes, channel that many runes plus 1 exhausted rune instead.
RAD-092.flavorText: The blessings of the Aspects are inscrutable to mortal minds.

RAD-093.name: Disposal Expert
RAD-093.rulesText:
I enter ready if you control no other units.
[Disarm 2]
RAD-093.flavorText: At least he's wearing safety goggles.

RAD-094.name: Explosimian
RAD-094.rulesText: When I hold, play three Bomb gear tokens to a single battlefield.

RAD-095.name: Momentary Companion
RAD-095.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, if it's not your turn, give me [Temporary].
RAD-095.flavorText: You'll forget what she took, but those eyes will stay with you forever.

RAD-096.name: Satchel Charge
RAD-096.rulesText:
[Action]
Move a friendly unit, then play a Bomb gear token to a battlefield.
RAD-096.flavorText: It's more fun if nobody knows how long the fuse is.

RAD-098.name: Siren's Song
RAD-098.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Move an enemy unit that moved this turn.

RAD-099.name: Suave Negotiator
RAD-099.rulesText: When you play me, choose an opponent. You and that player each draw 1.

RAD-100.name: The Waters' Wage
RAD-100.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Play a Gold gear token exhausted. If it's your turn and you played this from face down, play three ready Gold gear tokens instead.

RAD-101.name: An Offer You Can't Refuse
RAD-101.rulesText:
[Action]
Kill a gear. Its controller plays a Gold gear token exhausted.

RAD-102.name: Demon Shade
RAD-102.rulesText:
[Hidden]
Choose a friendly unit, then choose one —
• Move it to an open battlefield.
• Give it [Ganking] this turn if there are no open battlefields.

RAD-103.name: Gutter Guardian
RAD-103.rulesText:
[Hidden]
[Show Off] a card with [Hidden].
When you play me, if you showed off, [Add] [A].
RAD-103.flavorText: Where cruelty reigns, kindness is rebellion.

RAD-104.name: Pitiless Stalker
RAD-104.flavorText: They savor their prey one nightmare at a time.

RAD-105.name: Reckless Innovator
RAD-105.rulesText:
[Accelerate]
When I become exhausted, choose one —
• Play a Gold gear token exhausted.
• Pay [P] to draw 1.

RAD-106.name: The Good Stuff
RAD-106.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this, discard 1, then draw 3.
When you hold here, return this to its owner's hand.

RAD-107.name: Bedeviling Stranger
RAD-107.rulesText:
[Hidden]
When you play me, choose a battlefield. If there are 4 or more units there, you may return an enemy unit there to its owner's hand.
RAD-107.flavorText: "Now lean in, friends, for I dare not say it above a whisper..."

RAD-108.name: Bushwhack Trap
RAD-108.rulesText:
[Deploy]
While you or an ally control this battlefield, that player may hide an additional card here.
RAD-108.flavorText:
"There, that should be the last of them."
—Common last words

RAD-109.name: Evelynn, In Control
RAD-109.rulesText:
[Disarm]
When I hold, if you control a facedown card here, score 1 point..
RAD-109.flavorText: "Just looking for that special someone to torment."

RAD-110.name: Lulu, Whimsical
RAD-110.rulesText: When I move, you may have another unit's base Might become 4 this turn.

RAD-111.name: Mechanical Bandit
RAD-111.rulesText: At the start of your Beginning Phase, each player reveals the top card of their Main Deck. If you revealed a card with the lowest Energy cost, draw it. Recycle the rest.

RAD-112.name: Ziggs, Explosive
RAD-112.rulesText:
[1], [E]: Play a Bomb gear token to a battlefield.
When I defend, you may kill a friendly gear to give me +2[M] this turn.

RAD-113.name: Angler Wyrm
RAD-113.rulesText:
[Deflect]
[E]: Choose an opponent. They must move a unit they control to my battlefield.
RAD-113.flavorText: The glimmer of hope comes just before the rip of teeth.

RAD-114.name: Riven, Deserter
RAD-114.rulesText:
When another friendly unit becomes exhausted, give me +1[M] this turn.
Exhaust a friendly unit: Ready a unit. Use this ability only once each turn.

RAD-115.name: Transpositionist
RAD-115.rulesText: [P], [E]: Return a friendly unit to its owner's hand. You may play a unit with less Might than that unit had, ignoring its cost.

RAD-116.name: Concert Poster
RAD-116.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this or when you conquer here, you may pay [1] to play a 1[M] Recruit unit token to your base.
RAD-116.flavorText: Nothing draws a crowd like a crowd.

RAD-117.name: For Demacia!
RAD-117.rulesText:
[Reaction]
Choose a battlefield. Give friendly units there [Shield 2] this turn.

RAD-118.name: Herald of the Emperor
RAD-118.rulesText: When you play me, choose a friendly unit. Its base Might becomes 5 this turn.

RAD-119.name: Hunting Dog
RAD-119.rulesText: [Deathknell][>] Play a 1[M] Bird unit token with [Deflect] to your base.
RAD-119.flavorText: You couldn't ask for a more loyal companion.

RAD-120.name: Meticulous Restorationist
RAD-120.rulesText: When you play a card with Energy cost [7] or more, you may play me from your trash for [Y].
RAD-120.flavorText: "I think we all deserve a second chance."

RAD-121.name: One-Two Punch
RAD-121.rulesText:
[Action]
[Buff] a friendly unit and [Stun] an enemy unit.
RAD-121.flavorText: Less of an accessory, more of a statement piece.

RAD-122.name: Party Crasher
RAD-122.rulesText:
I cost [1] less for each exhausted unit you control.
[Tank]

RAD-124.name: Burn Away
RAD-124.rulesText: Banish a unit with 3[M] or less or a gear. [Burn 2].

RAD-125.name: Dune Devourer
RAD-125.rulesText:
You may kill a friendly unit as an additional cost to play me. If you do, I cost [2] less.
[Deflect]
RAD-125.flavorText: Deep in the desert lie places that are scarcely our world at all.

RAD-126.name: Mournful Spirit
RAD-126.rulesText: [Deathknell][>] You may kill a unit or gear here.
RAD-126.flavorText: You can convince him to leave, but not alone.

RAD-127.name: Rousing Display
RAD-127.rulesText:
[Show Off] a card with Energy cost [7] or more.
Play two 1[M] Recruit unit tokens to your base. If you showed off, play four to your base instead.

RAD-128.name: Steadfast Outrider
RAD-128.rulesText:
[Tank]
While there are 2 or more other friendly units and/or gear at my battlefield, I have +2[M].

RAD-129.name: Trifarian Captain
RAD-129.rulesText: When you play me, look at the top 4 cards of your Main Deck. You may reveal from among them a unit or gear with Energy cost no more than [3] and with Power cost no more than [A] and draw it. Recycle the rest.

RAD-130.name: Battlefield Armorer
RAD-130.rulesText: When a friendly gear at a battlefield dies, you may pay [1] to return it to its owner's hand.
RAD-130.flavorText: "People are like old steel. They can break a few times and come back stronger."

RAD-131.name: Demacian Illuminators
RAD-131.rulesText: When one or more friendly units die, [Buff] a friendly unit.
RAD-131.flavorText: "To sacrifice the meek is to deny your duty."

RAD-132.name: Heimerdinger, Academy Instructor
RAD-132.rulesText: If you would play a unit token to a location while I'm at a battlefield, you may play a 3[M] Mech unit token to that same location instead.

RAD-133.name: Jarvan IV, Royal Heir
RAD-133.rulesText:
[Assault]
[Tank]
When I attack, you may move a unit you control to my battlefield.

RAD-134.name: Raucous Anthem
RAD-134.rulesText: Ready your units and give them +3[M] this turn.

RAD-135.name: Remember the Fallen
RAD-135.rulesText: Play up to 3 units and/or gear from your trash, each with Energy cost no more than [3] and Power cost no more than [A], ignoring their costs.
RAD-135.flavorText: A cherished memory. A sacred trust.

RAD-136.name: Dockside Lock-Up
RAD-136.rulesText:
[Deploy]
When you play this, banish a unit here.
When you hold here, kill this to play the banished card, ignoring its cost.
RAD-136.flavorText: "Can't say I hate the time away from work."

RAD-137.name: Mordekaiser, Dominating
RAD-137.rulesText: When you play me or when I attack, you may discard 1 to kill a unit or gear.
RAD-137.flavorText: "I carve my kingdom beyond, from beyond the ashes of nothing. No mortals, not even gods, will stop me from claiming what is mine."

RAD-138.name: Seraphine, Not Alone
RAD-138.rulesText:
When you play me or when I become exhausted, play a 1[M] Recruit unit token to your base.
I have +1[M] for each other exhausted unit you control.
RAD-138.flavorText: "I sing to help them find themselves. The stage just makes it easier."

RAD-139.name: Ekko, Boy Who Shattered Time
RAD-139.rulesText:
[Empower] — [1], [E]
Disempower me, [E]: Reduce the cost of the next unit you play this turn by [2][A] and give it "Kill me at end of turn."

RAD-140.name: Chronobreak
RAD-140.rulesText:
As an additional cost to play this, pay any amount of Power.
Banish that many units you control, then for each, its owner plays that unit back to the same location or to their base, ignoring its cost.

RAD-141.name: Ziggs, Hexplosives Expert
RAD-141.rulesText: [1][A], [E]: Play a bomb gear token to a battlefield.

RAD-142.name: Hexplosive Minefield
RAD-142.rulesText:
[Action]
Kill any number of friendly Bomb tokens. At end of turn, play that many Bomb tokens to a single battlefield.

RAD-143.name: Mordekaiser, Iron Revenant
